params.requirement: Answers a fixed set of typed choices about one short spoken or typed request: which way it should be answered (small talk, a quick answer, careful reasoning or deep research), what the person wants, and which needs and tool families it has. It needs a fast, cheap decider that returns a calibrated probability per answer, never generated text. It runs on every turn while the person waits for the answer, so an answer must come back within a few hundred milliseconds and cost next to nothing.

model.description: The decider's model id, set by the model registry's overlay or the instance's `override_params`. Empty as shipped: every turn's stamp is then `talk` with `p` 0, because the decider answers with an error. Changed at runtime by the model registry's overlay.

api_key.description: The decider's key. Leave it EMPTY when `credential_grant_id` is set: the empty key is the switch, because the cell asks for a credential only while it holds none, and a key in its config counts as one. Deprecated, removed in 0.63.0: name a grant in credential_grant_id instead (#801).

credential_grant_id.description: The grant this decider presents to get its bearer credential SEALED from the member's own access hive, the same param with the same meaning as on talky's `./brain` (GH #560, GH #976). It ships EMPTY, which is no grant at all: the decider then spends `api_key`. Set it, with an EMPTY `api_key`, through `override_params` of the declaration that installs the talky: the request leaves on `credential_request` from `./decide` and the sealed box comes back on `in_sealed` at `./decide` (both declared at the talky rim). Immutable at run time.

credential_wait_ms.description: How long one sealed credential round may take before every parked call gets its `credential_pending` error, which `./route` reads as `talk`. Only meaningful together with `credential_grant_id`.

base_url_allow.description: The origins (`scheme://host[:port]`) a push of the model registry may move `base_url` to. Empty as shipped, so a push that carries an endpoint is refused (`model_refused`) until the set that installs the talky lists the endpoint of its decisions rows here (`override_params`). Immutable at run time.

description.purpose: talky's decider (GH #1247): ONE call per turn from `./route` over a fixed set of questions -- the class of the turn, its intent, its needs and its tool families -- answered as one `decision` with a confidence per answer.
description.use_when: Always, as part of talky; born with `provider: decisions`, which never changes after spawn.
description.not_in_scope: It sees the turn's text and the descriptions of the options -- never memory, never the window. No tools, no chat model: the registry never hands this cell one.
